heading: ‘Mard ki aulaad maanunga…’: Why BJP MP Nishikant Dubey filed defamation case against ex-Finance Secretary Subhash Garg
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: The legal action by Nishikant Dubey follows a public feud sparked by ex-Finance Secretary Subhash Garg, who earlier questioned the official Q1 GDP growth data.
